listing.name: Ashpad
listing.summary: Overhauls the game's UI to fit a specific faction's aesthetic, changing colors and entire components.
listing.aiSummary: Overhauls the game's UI to fit a specific faction's aesthetic, changing colors and entire components.

description:
Ashpad

Based on the design and schematics acquired through """perfectly""" legal means and a few bribers, Sophia Anderson, Head of R&D of a newly created faction, has developed her own personal variant of Tri-pad with her vision and ambition in mind. She named it Ash-pad, to sarcastically portray how many backup save disks have been burned, whenever she introduced new massive changes.

Info

As shown in the images below, Ash-pad changes the UI throughout the game to fit Sophia's wishes, changing not only colors but entire components as a whole.

Note:

For load-order purposes, the launcher & TriOS will show the mod name to be "Aashpad"

Spoiler

Campaign layer

Menu example

Refit screen

Click here to download

Current version : 1.0.1 (Safe to add mid save, compatible with v1.0.0)

Latest changelog v1.0.1

- Fixed UI component in the top right of menus & Lunasettings screen

- Added version file support

Incompatible mods

Any mod that also changes the UI

(Probably wouldn't crash but, issues would most likely appear)

Special thanks

Static: Heavy lifting on the UI components

Kaysaar: Ashes of The Domain
